purpose: Precommit the statistical interpretation of the fresh corrected-deadline service-guard holdout before its outcomes are inspected.
paired_unit: holdout seed within operating regime; each seed deterministically defines the matched synthetic mobility scenario and traffic trace for selected candidate and reactive baseline

interval.method: paired percentile bootstrap over seed-level differences

multiplicity.confirmatory_tests: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on goodput for the four regimes, when defined
multiplicity.correction: Holm across the four regime-level primary tests

secondary_interpretation: descriptive and mechanism-supporting; do not override primary goodput classification
guardrails: Do not alter the corrected-development-selected candidate after holdout inspection.
Do not redefine regimes, seeds, practical margin, confidence level, bootstrap count, or classification thresholds after holdout inspection.
If the corrected development gate selects no candidate, do not inspect holdout outcomes for selection.
Do not reuse the historical 202611/202612 service-guard seeds for the corrected evidence instance.
Treat the historical service-guard artifact as pre-correction evidence, not final corrected inference.
Treat this as synthetic model-based evidence, not WOMD or measured-channel evidence.
